name: MOOD
source:
Dark clouds above your head and snow mixed with mud under your feet, stable way home to work and repeat. This city has never given bright colors and happy memories. Everyday you're questioning validity of your life and losing hope for any changes. However, sudden headache disrupts the usual order of things, which led to this mystical encounter with a strange girl. Will this be a beginning of something new? Or it will be a horrible mistake?

[From [url=https://tenebraestudio.itch.io/mood-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
头顶乌云密布，脚下雪花夹杂泥浆，回家上班又重复。这座城市从来没有给予过鲜艳的色彩和幸福的回忆。每天你都会质疑自己生活的有效性，并对任何改变失去希望。然而，突然的头痛打乱了一切的正常秩序，导致了与陌生女孩的神秘邂逅。这会是新事物的开始吗？或者这将是一个可怕的错误？

[来自[url=https://tenebraestudio.itch.io/mood-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
